text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Miracle-san!! Please 
accept this gift, fitting for a class rep!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Birthday"... What a pleasant word. The 
lack of curves in its written form is also 
splendid. My congratulations—no, blessings 
be upon you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, both of you. Going out of your 
way just for someone like meâ

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on! It's too early to thank me! 
I haven't even handed you your present 
yet, have I?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Here, this is from me! A Bakushin letter 
filled with heartfelt gratitude for you, 
Miracle-san!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Breaking away with overwhelming speed as 
if staking her very existence, heading for 
the goal...! Truly the spitting image of a 
model class rep!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Your presence inspires me as I strive to 
become the ultimate class representative! 
Therefore, as a token of my esteem, I 
confer upon you the title of Honorary 
Class Representative!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I shall also convey the feelings in my 
heart straight to you. Ahem. "An 
unwavering trajectory displayed in your 
spurt. Faster than anyone else present... 
straight and beautiful."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It is truly fitting that you receive the 
'Straightforward Award.' In honor of your 
achievements, we present you with this 
letter and a ruler to symbolize your 
straightness!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I feel like both are praising me a bit too 
much, but... Hehe, I'm really happy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't be so modest! Your very 
existence is one of the driving forces for 
both me and Right O-san, Miracle-san!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A driving force, huh... I get a lot of 
energy from the two of them too, so I 
suppose that means I'm repaying the favor.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If we keep pushing each other higher, 
we can become endlessly faster. Yes, so 
fast that every track feels like a 
straight line!
